[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling==1.28.0"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "my-career-training"
version = "0.3.0"
description = "A local Rocket League career and practice companion"
requires-python = ">=3.12,<3.13"
license = "LicenseRef-Proprietary"
license-files = ["LICENSE"]
dependencies = [
  "PySide6-Essentials==6.12.0",
  "psutil==7.2.2",
  "rlbot==2.0.0b56; sys_platform == 'win32'",
  "rlbot-flatbuffers==0.19.0; sys_platform == 'win32'",
  "pygame-ce==2.5.6",
  "numpy==2.1.3; sys_platform == 'win32'",
  "torch==2.6.0; sys_platform == 'win32'",
]

[project.scripts]
my-career-training = "my_career_training.__main__:main"

[dependency-groups]
dev = ["pytest==9.0.2", "ruff==0.14.14", "pyinstaller==6.22.3", "pyinstaller-hooks-contrib==2026.9"]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/my_career_training"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["src"]

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py312"
line-length = 110

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E4", "E7", "E9", "F"]

[[tool.uv.index]]
name = "pytorch-cpu"
url = "https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu"
explicit = true

[tool.uv.sources]
torch = [{ index = "pytorch-cpu", marker = "sys_platform == 'win32'" }]
